# Version 4.153.0
> **Font selection and GPU reliability** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 brings Skia m153 with Linux font-selection changes and GPU rendering corrections.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pin fonts when fallback selection must be deterministic** — On Linux, Skia tries FcFontMatch before the former FcFontSort fallback. Applications relying on the exact fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics. Select an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic selection matters; managed signatures and the native C ABI are unchanged. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Engine

- **Skia m153** — Updates the engine to milestone 153. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.2.1.300 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## Bug Fixes

- **Glyph-atlas and GPU failures** — Prevents stale glyph-atlas reuse after partial updates and propagates Ganesh task, flush, and GPU-buffer upload failures rather than drawing stale data. Managed flush operations remain void. ([#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))
- **Cached-data destruction** — Releases the cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, avoiding a native use-after-free. ([#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))
- **Windows HarfBuzz scanning compatibility** — Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged. ([#5120](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5120))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

Windows HarfBuzz native assets no longer trigger BinSkim BA2007 for disabled compiler warnings. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged.

## Release Candidate 1 (September 6, 2026)

Prepared the m153 line for stable release with internal backport automation changes and no additional collected product changes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6...v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

## Preview 1 (September 3, 2026)

Introduced Skia m153 and its Linux fallback-font selection change, and corrected cached-data mutex lifetime. The HarfBuzz package revision changes without a native HarfBuzz upgrade.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.152.3...v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6)
